questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The Moon has no atmosphere mainly because:
options: It is too far from the Sun
Its escape velocity of about 2.4 km/s is less than the mean speed of gas molecules there
It has no gravity at all
questions.explanation: A low escape velocity lets gas molecules leak away into space over time. The Earth's much higher value of 11.2 km/s is what holds its atmosphere in place.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Steel is said to be more elastic than rubber because for the same applied stress, steel:
options: Shows a much smaller strain, so its Young's modulus is far greater
Does not return to its original shape
questions.explanation: Elasticity in physics means the tendency to resist deformation and recover fully, not stretchiness. Rubber stretches far more for the same stress, so it is less elastic.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 8: Mechanical Properties of Solids

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The capacitive reactance of a capacitor of capacitance C in an AC circuit of angular frequency ω is:
questions.explanation: Since Xc = 1/ωC, a capacitor offers infinite reactance to DC, where ω = 0, and very little to high frequency AC, which is why capacitors are used to block DC and pass signals.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: The correct order of stability of free radicals is:
questions.explanation: Alkyl groups stabilise the electron deficient radical centre by hyperconjugation and the +I effect, exactly the order seen for carbocations.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 8: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Reverse osmosis is used for the desalination of sea water. In this process:
options: Pure water is pushed out of the sea water by applying a pressure greater than its osmotic pressure
Salt is pushed through the membrane
Water flows from the dilute side to the concentrated side
The membrane is permeable to salt only
questions.explanation: Applying excess pressure on the concentrated side reverses the normal direction of osmosis, so solvent leaves the solution and pure water collects on the other side.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In the Hell-Volhard-Zelinsky reaction, a carboxylic acid is treated with chlorine or bromine in the presence of red phosphorus to give:
questions.explanation: Only acids with an alpha hydrogen respond, so formic acid does not. The alpha halo acid is a valuable intermediate for making amino acids and hydroxy acids.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 8: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: A test cross is performed by crossing an individual showing the dominant phenotype with a:
options: Homozygous recessive individual, to find out whether it is homozygous or heterozygous
questions.explanation: If any recessive offspring appears, the tested parent must have been heterozygous. All dominant offspring means it was homozygous dominant.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 4: Principles of Inheritance and Variation

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The occurrence of different shapes of leaves on the same plant, as in the aquatic buttercup, is an example of:
questions.explanation: The submerged leaves are finely dissected while the aerial ones are broad, showing that development can change with the environment. Cotton and coriander show the same with age.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 13: Plant Growth and Development

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Asthma is characterised by difficulty in breathing because of:
options: Permanent destruction of the alveolar walls
Inflammation of the bronchi and bronchioles, which narrows the airways
Fibrosis of the lung from stone dust
questions.explanation: The narrowing causes wheezing and is usually reversible, often triggered by an allergen. Emphysema instead destroys alveolar walls permanently.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 14: Breathing and Exchange of Gases

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Lamarck's theory of inheritance of acquired characters was rejected mainly because:
options: Acquired somatic changes are not transmitted to the germ cells, so they are not inherited
Lamarck had no examples at all
It agreed too closely with Darwin
Giraffes do not have long necks
questions.explanation: Only changes in the DNA of the gametes pass to the next generation. Weismann's experiments on cutting the tails of mice over generations supported this conclusion.
